versions.content: Using secure channels shall be transparent on the communica- tion API Status: DRAFT Description: Communication through configured secure channels shall be facilitated transparently by the communication stack. Communicating through a secured channel shall make no difference for the application. Rationale: Reduce maintenance effort of Adaptive Application code Dependencies: – Use Case: Application code may be reused to transfer data with different security requirements. Supporting Material: –
